title: HEARING COMMENTS relative to an Application for Determination of Public Convenience or Necessity for the sale of alcoholic beverages for off-site…
text:
[Council File 26-1342; CD 11]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
HEARING COMMENTS relative to an Application for Determination of Public Convenience or Necessity for the sale of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption at Trader Joe's (Store 255), located at 620 South Lincoln Boulevard (604-620 South Lincoln Boulevard, 909-935 East Vernon Avenue, 860-934 East Sunset Avenue).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. DETERMINE that the issuance of a liquor license at Trader Joe's (Store 255), located at 620 South Lincoln Boulevard (604-620 South Lincoln Boulevard, 909-935 East Vernon Avenue, 860-934 East Sunset Avenue), will serve the Public Convenience or Necessity and will not tend to create a law enforcement problem.
2. GRANT the Application for Determination of Public Convenience or Necessity for the sale of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption at Trader Joe's (Store 255), located at 620 South Lincoln Boulevard (604-620 South Lincoln Boulevard, 909-935 East Vernon Avenue, 860-934 East Sunset Avenue).
3. INSTRUCT the City Clerk to transmit this determination to the State Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control as required findings under Business and Professions Code Section 23958.4.
Applicant: Trader Joe's Company
Representative: Dan Kramer - Dan Kramer Law Group
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 21, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 15, 2026

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted (Nov 6, 2026); Council action final
